doors.name: Door to your room
doors.text: Plywood on a steel frame. Your door; it has not locked properly in years.

doors.name: Room 2-D
doors.text: A steel door at the cold end of the corridor. Security's padlock is through the hasp. Nobody has lived here for years.

props.name: Your bunk

props.name: Your toolbox

inspect.name: Graffiti
inspect.text: HEAT IS RANK, sprayed over the old WARMTH FOR ALL poster, with an arrow pointing down towards the warm levels. A child's handwriting, or someone who wanted it to look like one.

inspect.name: Radiator
inspect.text: Dead. Frost in the fins. The far end of the branch never gets enough flow, so the water barely moves out here.

inspect.name: Radiator
inspect.text: Your radiator. Warm, mostly: your room is near the start of the branch.

inspect.name: Civil defence sign
inspect.text: Blue triangle on orange: civil defence. Painted when the silo was new.

inspect.name: Intercom
inspect.text: The line to Engineering. It still smells of Mira's solder.

inspect.name: Drawing
inspect.text: A child's drawing of a sky: blue, with a yellow sun. Nobody in Silo 81 has seen one.
